title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Anime Reveals Action Trailer
content:
The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life has revealed a new action trailer ahead of the anime’s October 2026 premiere. The anime was announced in February.

Animated by P.A.WORKS, the fantasy series follows Rein Garland, an enchantment mage who is expelled from his guild despite spending years strengthening their equipment. As it goes, after reclaiming every enhancement he had placed on his former comrades’ gear, Rein sets off on a new adventure and discovers the true potential of his abilities.

The voice cast for the anime includes:

• Daiki Yamashita as Rein Garland, the protagonist

• Lynn as Lily Flambert, S-rank adventurer

• Yoshino Aoyama as Margaret Els

• Miyu Tomita as Mirabelle

• Megumi Han as Elsie Sora

• Konomi Kohara as Nina

• Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hanbun

• Makoto Furukawa as Cornelius

• Rie Shibata as the Mother of Assassins

The anime is directed by Shu Honma at P.A.WORKS. Series composition is handled by Yoko Yonaiyama, while Tadahito Kiyosawa will serve as the character designer and co-chief animation director alongside Masami Gohda, who also handles gag and sub-character designs. You can watch the new trailer below.

The anime will adapt the manga version illustrated by Gyomuyomochi, which is significantly different from Rokushima’s original light novels. K-Manga has the manga available in English, describing the story:

Rein the Enchanter is a support mage with the ability to enhance weapons and armor. But when he gets fired from his guild for the simple reason that he’s already enchanted everything they own, he decides to take the power back into his own hands—literally! Rein recalls every enchantment he ever put on his guildmates’ gear, retrieving the bonus points for himself. But does he really not have anything better to enchant with them than some Plain Clothes and a Copper Sword…? Come along on a cheat-tier journey from the most common of common origins!

Studio P.A. WORKS’ recent anime adaptations include Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze and Skip and Loafer , while some of their recent original works include Mayonaka Punch , Food for the Soul , and last season’s Dusk Beyond the End of the World . The studio’s founder, Kenji Horikawa, also spoke about the difficulties of creating original works as compared to adaptations, saying “ But, if the current situation continues, I feel a sense of crisis that even if we all want to, we might forget how to make an original work. “

Tsuiho Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life o Oka Suru , commonly called Chii Fuyo , is a Japanese web novel by Asa Rokushima that started on Shosetsuka ni Naro in January 2021. Kodansha later released two light novel volumes with illustrations by Kisui in 2022. The manga version by Mochi Gyomuyo began in Shonen Magazine R in October 2021, moved to Monthly Maga Kichi in February 2023, and is also available on Comic Days and Magazine Pocket.
author: Anime Corner

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Casts Takeo Ōtsuka
content:
The official X/Twitter account for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Wednesday that Takeo Ōtsuka will play Yamanaka Keisuke ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first here ):

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

The anime will premiere in January 2027 on the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks. There will be an early theatrical preview screening in 2026.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.

title: Live-Action Can You Kiss Me First? Series Unveils More Cast
content:
The official website for the live-action series of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga unveiled a new visual and cast members for the series on Wednesday.

The new cast members include ( Note: Character name romanizations not official ):

(Top row, left to right in image above):

• Yoshiki Kanemaru as Tōma Fujisawa

• Tsubasa Kizu as Yūsuke Kobayashi

• Riko Kawase as Akira Mizoguchi

• Kōya Matsuda as Kōtarō Shirai

(Bottom row, left to right in image above):

• Jun Yamasaki as Satoshi Kanda

• Kakeru Amemiya as Takumi

• Sōshō Tomimoto as Yūto Shima

• Aika Sonoda as Yuika Nakagawa

The series will star Jin Suzuki (live-action Kimi ni Todoke , Teasing Master Takagi-san , left in image above) as Ueno, and Gaku Oshida (live-action Grapara! , Samurai Sensei, right) as Kanda.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and will begin releasing it in September. Seven Seas Entertainment describes the story:

Ueno and Kanada seem like two complete opposites in the office. Ueno is an accountant who can strike fear into his co-workers with his strict and unbending ways. Meanwhile, Kanda is the superstar of the sales department—and thanks to his friendly and outgoing personality, he is even next in line to be manager! While most would think these two could never mesh, the truth is they're actually very close friends outside of work.

Kanda often crashes at Ueno's place, and the two spend time with each other constantly, growing closer than most co-workers would. But when Ueno confesses to Kanada that he's gay, a myriad of unsaid feelings begin to grow between them. Ueno has mixed feelings about how close and touchy Kanada can be, while Kanada is hung up on the fact that Ueno claimed he wasn't his type!

Can these two salarymen navigate their true feelings and realize the growing love between them?

Meigetsu Takahashi is directing the series, with scripts by Emi Amamoto. Nobuhiro Tateno and Ami Yamashita are composing the music.

The series will debut on Fuji TV this fall, and will also stream on Fuji TV On Demand .

The manga serialized on Renta! from March 2023 to April 2024. Takeshobo published one compiled book volume for the manga.
author: ANN

title: Vermeil in Gold Manga Artist Yōko Umezu Dies
content:
The editors for Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine announced on Wednesday that manga artist Yōko Umezu had died on July 7 due to cerebral infarction (ischemic stroke). The magazine's editors stated that a private funeral was held, attended only by close relatives.

The editors also announced that Vermeil in Gold ( Kinsō no Vermeil: Gakeppuchi Majutsushi wa Saikyō no Yakusai to Mahō Sekai o Tsukisusumu ), Kōta Amana and Umezu's manga that serialized in Monthly Shonen Gangan , has ended with the chapter that ran in the magazine's July issue on June 12. The editorial staff added that they will announce details regarding the publication of the series' uncollected chapters at a later date.

Amana and Umezu launched the manga in Monthly Shonen Gangan in August 2018. Square Enix published the manga's 11th compiled book volume on June 11. Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service and Comikey both publish the manga in English digitally.

The manga's television anime adaptation premiered in July 2022. HIDIVE streamed the anime as it aired in Japan, and also streamed an English dub .

Umezu also drew the Minidura spinoff manga of Ryohgo Narita 's Durarara!! light novel series, which ran in Kadokawa 's Dengeki Maoh magazine from 2013 to 2015.

title: 'Tank Chair' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Manabu Yashiro 's Tank Chair manga revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 11:00 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS11, CBC, and MBS.

Cast Dr. Radio: Yurina Amami ( Sayounara Ryuusei, Konnichiwa Jinsei ) Uzu: Gen Satou ( Dr. Stone ) Gorou Arashiyama: Nobuyuki Hiyama ( Bleach ) Ryou Takanashi: Houchuu Ootsuka ( Sakamoto Days ) Yoshitsune: Tetsu Inada ( Boku no Hero Academia )

Staff Production Design: Kazuma Teshigahara ( Ooyukiumi no Kaina ) CG Supervisor: Kousuke Kawamura ( Mayo Chiki! ) Modeling Supervisor: Daiki Seo Environment Supervisor: Tsubasa Hirata Rigging Supervisor: Mai Kawano Look Development Supervisor: Shinnosuke Takizawa Animation Supervisor: Kazumasa Izawa ( Kuutei Dragons ), Shou Okajima, Shogo Tezuka BG Set-up Supervisor: Iori Suetsugu Art Director: Yoshikatsu Matsumoto ( Kamierabi ) Color Design: Hironori Noji ( Snowball Earth ) Effects Supervisor: Taichi Sudou ( Kuutei Dragons ) Motion Graphics Supervisor: Tatsuya Kuwahara ( Ajin graphic design) Lighting, Composite Supervisor: Kaoru Tadokoro Editing: Hiroaki Sasa Sound Director: Masaki Tsuchiya ( Fate/strange Fake ) Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi ( Kaya-chan wa Kowakunai )

J-Rock band SiM ( Black Torch ) is performing the opening theme "DALALA." Singer Daoko ( Yowayowa Sensei ) is performing the ending theme "SYNC." The opening theme is previewed in the first promotional video below.

Tadahiro Yoshihira ( Kuutei Dragons ) and Hiroaki Andou ( Ajin ) are directing and penning the script at Polygon Pictures . Yoshihira is handling the series composition, and Yuuki Moriyama ( Sidonia no Kishi ) is designing the characters. Masaru Yokoyama ( Mashle ) is composing the music.

Yashiro originally began drawing the action super power manga on the Magazine pocket platform in November 2022 before switching it to Monthly Shounen Sirius in November 2024. Kodansha published the tenth volume on March 26.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in October 2023 and released the ninth volume on August 11.

title: Tank Chair Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Song Artists, October 4 Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks presented the main promotional video, key visual, additional cast and staff members, theme song artists, and October 4 premiere for the television anime of Manabu Yashiro 's Tank Chair manga on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "DALALA" by reggae-punk band SiM . Musical artist Daoko is performing the ending theme song 'SYNC."

The newly announced cast members are:

Yurina Amami as Dr. Radio, a genius scientist living in hiding in an abandoned radio tower

Gen Sato as Uzu, a mysterious newcomer who joins the Class A of the "Academy"

The visual for the character Sensei, an absolute ruler with unfathomable menace and overwhelming power, and the founder of the "Academy," was also revealed:

The additional staff members are:

• CG Supervisor: Kōsuke Kawamura

• Modeling Supervisor: Daiki Seo

• Environment Supervisor: Tsubasa Hirata

• Rigging Supervisor: Mai Kawano

• Look Development Supervisor: Shinnosuke Takizawa

• Layout/Animation Supervisors: Kazukatsu Izawa, Shō Okajima, Shogo Tezuka

• BG Set-up Supervisor: Iori Suetsugu

• Art Director: Yoshikatsu Matsumoto

• Color Key Artist: Hironori Nochi

• Effects Supervisor: Taichi Sudou

• Motion Graphic Supervisor: Tatsuya Kuwahara

• Lighting and Composite Supervisor: Kaoru Tadokoro

• Editing: Hiroaki Sasa

• Sound Director: Masanori Tsuchiya

• Sound Effects: Hiromune Kurahashi

The anime will premiere on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 11:00 p.m. JST (10:00 a.m/ EDT), then on BS11 at 24:30 JST (effectively October 5 at 12:30 a.m. JST). The anime will then air on the CBC channel on October 5, and on MBS on October 6.

Kodansha USA Publishing has licensed the series, and it describes the story:

Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

The anime stars:

• Kōki Uchiyama as Nagi Taira

• Minori Fujidera as Shizuka Taira

• Gakuto Kajiwara as Naozumi Kurosaka

• Saori Hayami as Touko Kurosaka

Tadahiro Yoshihira ( Knights of Sidonia: Love Woven in the Stars ) and Hiroaki Ando ( Kaina of the Great Snow Sea , Ajin ) are directing the anime and writing the scripts at Polygon Pictures . (Yoshihira is also supervising the overall series scripts.) Yūki Moriyama ( Blame! ) is designing the characters. Masaru Yokoyama ( Mashle: Magic and Muscles , Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans ) is composing the music. Kazuma Teshigahara ( Kaina of the Great Snow Sea ) is credited for production design.

Kodansha 's K MANGA service is also publishing the series.

Yashiro debuted the manga on Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket service in November 2022. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in November 2024. Kodansha published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on March 26.

title: Crunchyroll to Release Makoto Shinkai's New Film Globally, Excluding Most of Asia
content:
Crunchyroll did not reveal details about Shinkai's new film, including its title.

Shinkai stated on social media in November 2025 he has been working on a "new film" alongside "dependable companions," adding that he could not yet formally announce the work.

Shinkai's Suzume ( Suzume no Tojimari ) film opened in Japan at #1 in November 2022. The film opened in North America in April 2023. Crunchyroll screened the film in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

Suzume ranked at #1 on its opening day on many countries' box office charts. It earned US$5,001,705 in its opening weekend in the U.S., and eventually earned over US$10 million in the country. It ended its theatrical run in Japan in May 2023 after earning 14.79 billion yen (about US$105.3 million) at the box office. title: Riddle Kamimura Ends Mikiri Kara Hajimeru Garyū Kenjutsu Manga
content:
The fantasy story centers on Rio, who lives in a border town. To protect himself, he signs up for swordsmanship lessons in the town's training grounds, but quickly loses hope in the tutelage there. But in a border town that is always close to danger, he decides he still needs to learn something, and resolves to teach himself the sword.

Kamimura launched the manga in Mag Garden 's Mag Comi website in June 2023. Mag Garden released the manga's fourth compiled book volume in October 2025.

Kamimura launched the Ex-Yakuza and Stray Kitten ( Hiroware Koneko to Moto Yakuza ) manga in Mag Garden 's MAGxiv on pixiv in August 2020, and ended it in September 2022. Mag Garden released the manga's fourth volume in September 2022. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga and released the fourth volume in December 2023.

Hisumi serialized the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website from 2021 to 2022. Kadokawa published the first print novel volume in April 2022, with illustrations by Nemusuke . The second volume shipped in January 2023.

Hisumi serialized the A Serious Error in Chihaya-chan's Reputation ( Chihaya-chan no Hyōban ni Shinkoku na Error ) story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website from 2022 to 2023. Kadokawa released the first print volume in August 2024, with illustrations by Doyou . Kadokawaw released the fifth novel volume on June 10. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the novels, and will release the first volume in January 2027 under its Airship imprint.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Mousetrap Premieres on Netflix on August 28
content:
Netflix will premiere its new mystery thriller series Mousetrap , based on the webtoon Field Mouse , on August 28. The company also unveiled the poster and English-subtitled teaser trailer:

The series follows reclusive novelist Moon-jae, whose life is turned upside down by a mysterious figure known only as "Field Mouse." In a desperate attempt to reclaim what he's lost, Moon-jae teams up with No-ja, a ruthless loan shark who once pursued him.

Hong-sun Kim directs the series, with Jun-yeol Ryu starring as Moon-jae, Kyung-gu Sul as loan shark Noja, and Kyoo-hyung Lee as detective Sun-yong.

Field Mouse was originally serialized from 2017-2020 by webtoon artist Ludovico. Its story is inspired by the Korean folktale "The Rate That Ate Fingernails," which tells the story of a rat that transforms into a human after consuming someone's fingernails.

An English version of the webtoon is not currently available.

title: Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
The September issue of Shueisha 's Bessatsu Margaret magazine announced on Wednesday that Haruno Aoyama and Haruka Chizu 's Tonari no Seki no Fukami-kun ga Idol ni Naru Kamo Shirenai (Fukami-kun, the Guy Sitting Next to Me, Might Become an Idol) manga will end in the magazine's next issue on September 11.

The manga centers on a high school girl otaku of idol audition programs. She plans to produce and turn her classmate into an idol.

The manga launched in Bessatsu Margaret in September 2025. Aoyama is credited for the original work and Chizu is drawing the manga. Shueisha published the manga's first compiled book volume on February 25, and the second volume on July 23.

Aoyama launched the Boku wa Chiisana Shotenin ( I'm an Inexperienced Bookstore Clerk. ) manga in Shueisha 's now defunct The Margaret magazine in 2019. The manga ended in its sixth and final volume in 2023.

Chizu launched the Snow Angel ( Kono Setsugen de Kimi ga Waratte Irareru yō ni or literally, May this snowfield keep you smiling all the time ) manga in Shogakukan 's Cheese! magazine in May 2023. The manga ended in its fourth and final volume, which shipped in December 2024 Viz Media licensed the manga and published the fourth volume in English on March 3.
